defects.title: a new run id on a used capture root crash-looped the collector
defects.fix: start_paper_lab.py refuses before launch (EXIT_CAPTURE_ROOT_CONFLICT = 5) and names --data-root/--resume

defects.title: the bar-close wait ignored the stop file, so every stop escalated to a kill
defects.fix: paper_loop.wait_for_cadence sleeps in slices and answers the same predicate

defects.title: the console spent 12.8 s per request on 25 tasklist spawns
defects.fix: one cached process table (PROCESS_TABLE_TTL_SECONDS); measured 65-130 ms

defects.title: the filter changed the URL but not the board
defects.fix: status_payload(args, filters) renders the filtered board in the same response

defects.title: the analyst exited when the run directory did not exist yet
defects.fix: the sidecar waits for the first signal stream instead of exiting

defects.title: PAPER_RUN.json is rewritten at shutdown without provider/environment/assets/timeframe
defects.impact: run provenance is lost and the verifier cannot check source against the provider (provider: null)

defects.title: the analyst re-selects the same NOT_CONFIGURED rows every pass
defects.impact: 15 of 21 signals never receive an analysis row (coverage 6/21)

defects.title: final_state is DEGRADED after a clean stop
defects.impact: system_state() counts stopped critical children as degradation; stop_report.verdict CLEAN is the authoritative field

defects.title: --restart overwrites LAB_RUN_REPORT.json and restarts heartbeat.jsonl
defects.impact: the previous window's report is replaced; its cycles survive in logs/paper.log

defects.title: the resumed capture declares 34 gaps in its own state
defects.impact: the manifest must classify them as RECOVERED/UNRECOVERABLE before the capture is used

defects.title: 9 set-difference test failures are environmental
defects.impact: 8 stale unversioned data/ artefacts + 1 concurrent capture digest; none touches a modified module and no regression is claimed
